title: BlackRock upgrades Treasurys, downgrades equities - TradingView
text: BlackRock upgrades Treasurys, downgrades equities 1 min read SHY TLT US10Y TIP BlackRock Investment Institute this week upgraded U.S. Treasurys and cut U.S. equities to neutral, ending a six-year underweight stance on government debt to lock in multi-decade high yields. The shift moves short-term Treasurys SHY to overweight and long-term Treasurys TLT to neutral after 10-year yields US10Y surpassed 5.3% to reach 24-year highs a couple of weeks ago. The move unwinds an underweight position the firm had maintained since October 2020, when 10-year yields sat near 0.9%. The 10-year yield’s ~110-basis-point increase this year has been driven mainly by higher real rates TIP rather than inflation expectations, Jean Boivin noted in a recent note. Intensifying competition for capital, alongside Middle East tensions and rising oil USO BNO prices, has prompted markets to price in an additional 160 basis points of Federal Reserve tightening over the next 12 months. "We think that is overdone," Boivin wrote, highlighting that higher yields now offer an attractive entry point and a 75-basis-point cushion against further yield increases before 12-month total returns turn negative. BlackRock sees the greatest opportunity at the front end of the curve as excessive rate-hike expectations unwind. To fund the Treasury upgrades, BlackRock closed its longstanding overweight position on U.S. equities SPY , shifted U.S. agency mortgage-backed securities to neutral, and trimmed its underweight in Japanese government bonds. "This is a short-term risk-management move, reflecting our belief that investors must be more dynamic in today's volatile macro and market regime," the note said. BlackRock reiterated its long-term conviction in AI AIQ AIEQ fundamentals, particularly in critical infrastructure and companies with strong earnings power above the cost of capital, while maintaining an overweight position in emerging market equities EEM .
